reply_text:
I answered Hollis in our direct message: he should keep Wednesday 11 Nov at 15:30 free for the Bittern call.

That time comes from what he told me in that same direct message on 14 Oct: his standing Bittern rollout call with the Tansleigh Packaging team would be on Wednesdays at 15:30 from then on. The call isn't on his calendar, so I don't know how long it runs. I suggested he add it as a recurring event. Nothing in #central-team changes that time.
